parsed.summary: After tracing the power rails, the dual-MCU interfaces, the sensor/peripheral I2C buses, the buck/LDO feedback networks and every component reference/value against the specification, the drawing matches the intended design: all parts (STM32H753VITx, STM32F405RGTx, BMI088, IIS2MDCTR, MPRLS0025PA00001A, TMP100, MAX-8Q, 24CW1280, PCA9685PW, W25N01GVZEIG_TR, INA219AIDCNR, MIC26903YJL-TR, LD39200PU33R, XT60-M, CH330, TDD01H0SB1R, ABM8G-25MHz) and the stated values (R_shunt=10 mΩ, L=15 µH, 5 V/3V3 rails) are present and correctly connected. The only apparent numeric mismatch is the PCA9685PW address (spec table says 0x40, schematic note and A0 tied to +3V3 say 0x41); this is not a behavior-changing deviation because the INA219 (also 0x40) shares the same SCL/SDA nets (NET0144/NET0137), so 0x41 is the electrically required, conflict-free value the reference design must use. The barometer RESET/EOC swap is a documented known bug and is excluded. No drawing-supported anomaly was found.
